title: bartlettina ehrenbergii
intro: Bartlettina ehrenbergii, commonly known as the Mexican mint or Mountain Mint, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of Bartlettina ehrenbergii include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and diterpenes, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-histaminic, and anti-cancer activities. Additionally, the plant's essential oils have been found to have anxiolytic and sedative effects, making it a potential natural remedy for stress and anxiety relief.
